panels.visual: King Minos on his throne in Knossos, stern, purple robe, double-axe emblem, a golden bull relief behind him
panels.caption: King Minos of Crete: his son Androgeos died in Athens.

panels.visual: Seven boys and seven girls from Athens standing in a line, frightened, drawing lots from a jar held by an official
panels.caption: Every nine years Athens must send seven boys and seven girls, chosen by lot.

panels.visual: The dark Labyrinth entrance at the foot of the palace, torches, a distant huge shadow of a bull-headed giant, young faces
panels.caption: Minos shut them in the Labyrinth, and the Minotaur takes them.

panels.visual: A ship with solid black sails leaving the harbour of Athens, grey sky, families waving from the shore
panels.caption: Their ship sails under black sails. No one has ever come back to change them to white.
